scenario: Adopt Lintwise as a required pre-merge check (eight engineers)

motion.text: The team will conduct a non-blocking Lintwise trial in its monorepo, evaluating findings quality, language coverage, cached runtime, and queue impact. Before a separate vote on required checks, the team will review source access and findings handling and define blocking rules, ownership, exceptions, and rollback.

objectors.reason: The motion still requires immediate mandatory adoption rather than the non-blocking trial and separate adoption decision discussed.
The motion still requires immediate adoption, while the discussion supports a non-blocking trial followed by a separate decision on required checks.

chairQuestions.topic: Prior Lintwise findings and CI overhead
chairQuestions.experience_sought: In your six-month use, what kinds of real bugs did Lintwise catch, and was the roughly four-minute overhead measured for the checker alone or the full CI run?
On your side project, what actionable findings or false positives did Lintwise produce, and did you measure its runtime?
